## Review checklist
- [ ] Name is correct and unambiguous
- [ ] Description is accurate and original
- [ ] Starting position is specific to this exercise
- [ ] Execution steps are correct and safe
- [ ] Muscle mappings are anatomically accurate
- [ ] Common mistakes are real and relevant
- [ ] Safety considerations are appropriate
- [ ] Equipment list is complete
